property.name: tenant
property.description: Null means platform-global metric, available to all tenants.

property.name: code
property.description: Stable machine key used in code (e.g. api_calls, seats, storage_bytes).

property.name: unit-label
property.description: Human label for the unit: 'requests', 'GB', 'seats'.

property.name: tenant
property.description: Null means platform-wide plan. Tenant-scoped plans are private to that tenant.

property.name: public
property.description: If false, the plan is only assignable by admins, not self-service.

property.name: currency
property.description: ISO 4217 currency code (EUR, USD, GBP…).

property.name: amount-cents
property.description: Price in the smallest currency unit. 999 = 9.99 EUR.

property.name: billing-interval
property.description: Overrides the plan billing-interval for this price point.

property.name: external-price-id
property.description: ID in an external billing provider (Stripe price ID, etc.).

property.name: limit-value
property.description: Units included in the bucket per period. Null when billing-mode=metered.

property.name: billing-mode
property.description: Controls how validar-operacion behaves when the bucket is exhausted (or for meterless plans). bucket → block at limit-value. metered → always allow, record overage for end-of-period invoicing. bucket-then-credits → block only when both bucket and credit-wallet are exhausted. bucket-then-metered → allow overage after bucket, charge per unit at period close.

property.name: overage-cents-per-unit
property.description: Charge per unit above limit-value. Required for billing-mode=metered and bucket-then-metered.

property.name: spend-cap-cents
property.description: Optional maximum overage charge per period before blocking, for metered modes. Protects clients from unexpectedly large bills. Null means no cap.

property.name: quantity
property.description: For per-seat plans, number of seats purchased.

property.name: last-billing-run
property.description: Last billing-run that processed this subscription. Used by generar-factura to skip already-billed subscriptions without full aggregate scan.

property.name: external-subscription-id
property.description: Reference to the subscription object in the external billing provider.

filter.name: billable
filter.description: Subscriptions that are active/past_due and ended their current period. Entry point for generar-factura.

action.name: cancel
action.description: Schedules cancellation at period end or immediately.

action.name: renew-period
action.description: Advances current-period-start/end to the next billing cycle.

property.name: legal-name
property.description: Company legal name as it appears on invoices.

property.name: tax-id
property.description: VAT / NIF / CIF used for invoicing and B2B tax exemption.

property.name: billing-email
property.description: Recipient for invoices and payment notifications. Independent of user emails.

property.name: country
property.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (ES, FR, DE…).

property.name: external-customer-id
property.description: Customer ID in the payment provider (Stripe cus_…, PayPal customer ID). Created lazily on first checkout or payment-method registration. This is the join key between the platform and the external billing provider.

property.name: tax-exempt
property.description: If true, invoices are generated without VAT (e.g. validated EU B2B VAT number).

property.name: balance
property.description: Current available credit units. Never goes below 0.

property.name: version
property.description: Optimistic lock counter. Incremented on every credit-transaction.

action.name: debit
action.description: Decrements balance by units. Requires version for optimistic locking. Fails if balance - units would go below 0 or if version has changed.

action.name: credit
action.description: Increments balance by units. Called after a credit-purchase is confirmed paid.

property.name: delta
property.description: Units added (positive) or removed (negative) from the wallet.

property.name: balance-after
property.description: Wallet balance immediately after this transaction was applied.

property.name: source-type
property.description: Entity type of the origin: credit-purchase | usage-event | billing-run | manual.

property.name: source-uid
property.description: UID of the source entity. Polymorphic reference paired with source-type.

property.name: units-purchased
property.description: Operational units added to the wallet when the payment is confirmed.

property.name: price-cents
property.description: Amount charged for this batch. Denominated in invoice.currency.

property.name: invoice
property.description: Invoice generated for this purchase. Null while pending checkout.

property.name: checkout-session
property.description: Redirect session used to pay for this purchase.

property.name: expires-at
property.description: Optional expiry for the purchased units. A scheduled job creates a credit-transaction(expiry) on this date.

property.name: credited-at
property.description: Timestamp when the units were actually added to the wallet (after payment confirmed).

action.name: confirm-payment
action.description: Called after payment succeeds. Credits the wallet and records the credit-transaction.

action.name: refund
action.description: Reverses the wallet credit via a credit-transaction(refund) before marking as refunded.

property.name: idempotency-key
property.description: Caller-provided key to prevent double-counting on retries.

property.name: source
property.description: Service that produced this event: consumir-coste | validar-operacion.

property.name: overage
property.description: True when the event was recorded above the plan entitlement limit.

property.name: metadata-json
property.description: Free JSON context: request-id, user uid, endpoint, etc.

property.name: quantity
property.description: Total accumulated units in the period.

property.name: overage-quantity
property.description: Units above the plan entitlement limit. Used by generar-factura to compute overage charges.

property.name: version
property.description: Optimistic lock counter. Incremented on every write by validar-operacion.

property.name: billed-in-run
property.description: Null until generar-factura processes this aggregate. Set atomically during billing run.

action.name: increment
action.description: Atomically increments quantity (+overage-quantity if above limit) and bumps version. Used by both validar-operacion and consumir-coste.

param.description: Expected current version for optimistic locking. Fails if version has changed.

action.name: recompute
action.description: Full recompute from usage-event rows. Used for reconciliation, not hot path.

action.name: mark-billed
action.description: Sets billed-in-run atomically. Called by generar-factura after creating the invoice-line.

property.name: tenant
property.description: Null means the run covers all tenants (platform-wide batch).

property.name: period-start
property.description: Start of the billing window this run covers.

property.name: period-end
property.description: End of the billing window this run covers.

property.name: triggered-by
property.description: Admin user who triggered the run. Null for scheduled runs.

property.name: invoices-created
property.description: Count of invoices generated by this run. Updated as the run progresses.

property.name: errors-json
property.description: Array of {subscription_uid, error_message} for any subscription that failed during the run.

action.name: increment-progress
action.description: Increments subscriptions-processed and invoices-created as the run advances.

property.name: billing-profile
property.description: Snapshot reference to the billing profile at invoice creation time. The profile data (legal-name, tax-id, address) may change later; the invoice preserves what was active when it was finalized.

action.name: finalize
action.description: Moves invoice from draft to open and sets issued-at.

property.name: meter
property.description: Only set for type=usage lines.

property.name: unit-amount-cents
property.description: Price per unit. Negative for credits.

property.name: amount-cents
property.description: quantity × unit-amount-cents, pre-computed.

property.name: amount-cents
property.description: Amount credited. Must be ≤ invoice amount-paid-cents.

property.name: mode
property.description: test uses sandbox credentials; live uses real money credentials. A platform typically has one gateway record per provider per mode.

property.name: display-name
property.description: Label shown to tenant-admins on the payment selection screen (e.g. 'Stripe', 'Redsys TPV').

property.name: logo-url
property.description: Provider logo URL shown on the selection UI.

property.name: public-key
property.description: Publishable key for client-side use (Stripe pk_test_… / pk_live_…).

property.name: private-key
property.description: Secret API key used server-side to create sessions and capture payments.

property.name: webhook-secret
property.description: Signing secret to verify incoming webhook payloads from this provider.

property.name: supported-currencies
property.description: Comma-separated ISO 4217 codes supported by this gateway config.

property.name: available-to-tenants
property.description: If false, the gateway is not shown on the tenant payment selection screen.

property.name: metadata-json
property.description: Provider-specific settings (Redsys terminal number, Stripe account ID for Connect, etc.).

allow.name: #only-for-root
allow.description: Only platform admins can configure payment gateways.

property.name: gateway
property.description: The platform-configured gateway this tenant has chosen.

property.name: external-customer-id
property.description: Customer ID created in the gateway for this tenant (Stripe cus_…). Null until first checkout or payment-method registration.

action.name: set-gateway
action.description: Switches the active gateway. Called when a tenant-admin picks a different provider.

set-null.description: Clears the old customer ID since the new gateway has no record of this tenant yet.

action.name: register-customer
action.description: Stores the external-customer-id returned by the gateway after the first checkout.

allow.name: #tenant-billing-admin
allow.description: Tenant billing-admins can view their own payment selection.

allow.name: #tenant-billing-admin
allow.description: Tenant billing-admins can change their gateway.

property.name: gateway
property.description: The gateway used for this session, resolved from tenant-payment-selection at session creation time.

property.name: external-session-id
property.description: Session ID returned by the payment provider API.

property.name: redirect-url
property.description: Provider-hosted payment page URL. The user is sent here.

property.name: success-url
property.description: URL the provider redirects to after a successful payment.

property.name: cancel-url
property.description: URL the provider redirects to when the user cancels.

property.name: mode
property.description: Inherited from provider-config.mode at session creation time. Ensures test sessions are never confused with live payments in reporting.

property.name: amount-cents
property.description: Amount presented to the provider. Matches invoice.amount-due-cents at creation time.

property.name: expires-at
property.description: When the provider session expires. After this, status must be set to expired.

property.name: webhook-payload-json
property.description: Last raw webhook payload received for this session. Stored for replay and auditing.

action.name: complete
action.description: Called by the webhook handler after verifying the payment succeeded.

action.name: expire
action.description: Called by a scheduled job or webhook when the provider session TTL elapses.

action.name: cancel
action.description: Called when the user returns via cancel-url.

action.name: record-webhook
action.description: Stores an incoming webhook payload without changing status, for replay.

property.name: gateway
property.description: The gateway where this payment method is registered. A tenant switching gateways must re-register their methods.

property.name: external-payment-method-id
property.description: Token in the billing provider. The actual card data is never stored here.

property.name: last4
property.description: Last 4 digits of card or IBAN, for display only.

property.name: brand
property.description: Card brand: visa, mastercard, amex, etc.

action.name: set-default
action.description: Marks this method as the default for automatic charges.

property.name: checkout-session
property.description: Set when the payment originated from a provider redirect. Null for direct/manual charges.

property.name: amount-cents
property.description: Positive for charges, negative for refunds.

property.name: mode
property.description: Inherited from the checkout-session or provider-config. test payments are excluded from revenue reporting.

property.name: external-payment-id
property.description: Charge or transfer ID in the billing provider.

property.name: failure-reason
property.description: Provider error message when status=failed.
